scenes.title: Mandate, reach, gap, per agent
steps: Mandate: what each AI system is for, and who answers
Reach: what the agent can access (credentials, tools, data)
Gap: the difference, measured per agent
scenes.caption: Our hypothesis, not their claim. Built from public pages only; nothing of theirs was tested.
say: A readiness check states the mandate in writing.
Their public pages do not say how agent reach is measured: that is where RiskMandate's measurement would fit.

For agentic AI, the mandate-to-reach gap is the demonstration.

scenes.text: From "we think" to "we can demonstrate": for agents, the proof is the gap between mandate and reach.

Measuring the gap per agent is what we would add, together.
